patch_description: Add a lightweight, fixed CZ gate immediately before the final Layer 5 RZ phase shift. This gate has zero parameter cost and only adds +1 depth. It captures residual correlations at the readout stage, following the pattern of mixed entanglers that proved successful in Layer 3. The CZ gate on qubits (5,7) is an allowed pair and will strengthen correlation between these qubits before final measurement, potentially improving both validation accuracy and reducing the train-test gap.
